extraction.text:
Gorli Vasu ServiceNow ITOM/ITSM Support | Developer | Administrator (4.8 years’ Experience)

Bangalore, India

Phone: +91-9398116466

Email: vgorli09@gmail.com

Professional Summary ServiceNow ITSM professional with almost 5 years of hands-on experience in Platform Support, Administration, and Development. Skilled in configuring and customizing ITSM modules, building Service Catalog workflows, developing automation using Flow Designer and scripting, and supporting platform operations.

Core Competencies Platform Administration:

Users, Groups, Roles, ACLs, Update Sets, CMDB, Notifications

ITSM Expertise:

Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, flow Designer

Development Skills:

JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer, Integrations (Rest/Soap), PowerShell Script

Support Skills:

L1-L3 Support, RCA, Troubleshooting, Documentation

Professional Experience: HCL Tech (Nov 2021 – July 2026) ServiceNow Support Engineer / Admin / Developer Project: RBI (4.8 years)

Provided end-to-end administration and support for core ITSM processes including

Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB, and Service Catalog.

Performed root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and coordinated with

technical teams to implement permanent fixes.

Created and optimized Service Catalog items, variables, and variable sets, integrating

them with Workflows, Flow Designer, and integration spokes.

Designed and implemented Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Access

Controls (ACLs), and UI customizations to enhance platform functionality.

Developed custom UI Pages, UI Actions, and UI Policies to streamline user

interactions and automate processes.

Managed priority/severity-based ticket queues, ensuring SLA compliance and timely

resolution across L1–L3 tickets.

Maintained CMDB accuracy through discovery validation, reconciliation, CI class



updates, and dependency mapping Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring secure and compliant user/role configurations.

Built and maintained data import sets, transform maps, and scheduled jobs to

automate data loads into the platform.

Performed ServiceNow version upgrades, including impact analysis, UAT, and post-

upgrade remediation.

Documented technical specifications, knowledge articles, and SOPs, improving

support efficiency.

Provided user training and knowledge transfer sessions to enhance end-user

adoption and reduce operational load.

Created custom reports and dashboards, giving leadership real-time visibility into

operational KPIs.

Partnered with process owners to continuously improve ITSM workflows and eliminate

manual activities.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams (Infra, Security, DevOps) for seamless

integration and process alignment.

Developed and maintained scripted REST APIs for custom integrations. • Designed and implemented REST API integrations with external systems to automate workflows and data exchange.

Configured and extended CMDB with discovery and service mapping to support ITOM. • Configured and managed ITSM and ITOM modules including Incident, Change, Problem, and Discovery.

Technical Skills Tools: ServiceNow, Power shell, Integrations, Jira, Active Directory, Okta, Collab

Education Bachelor of Technology (B-Tech)

Certification CSA (Certified System Administrator)

CAD (Certified Application Developer)

ServiceNow Micro-Certified professional with knowledge of specialized ServiceNow platform capabilities, configuration practices, and implementation best practices.

Applied ServiceNow Micro-Certification knowledge to enhance ITSM/ITOM workflows, automation, integrations, and platform administration activities.
